Package arcade.patch.agent.module

Class PatchModule

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.agent.module.PatchModule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Module
Direct Known Subclasses:
PatchModuleApoptosis, PatchModuleCytotoxicity, PatchModuleMigration, PatchModuleNecrosis, PatchModuleProliferation, PatchModuleQuiescence, PatchModuleSenescence, PatchModuleStimulation
public abstract class PatchModule extends Object implements Module
Abstract implementation of Module for PatchCell agents.

Each module represents the behaviors of a cell in a given state.
